title: Walter Presents transition
slide_intent: Connect a collection to its parent brand through an ordered handoff so the viewer understands both identities.
strategic_value: A Channel 4 world between footage and the Walter Presents signature can preserve collection character within the masterbrand.
demonstration: The film moves from forest footage and a green 4 into a gradient room, then a Walter Presents panel and a drama shot reflected in a car mirror.
practical_value: Compare the parent-logo interval with the collection-signature interval.

content_islands.name: Programme footage
content_islands.spec: Begin with the forest image, then return to a dramatic scene at the end.

content_islands.name: Identity handoff
content_islands.spec: Move vertically through the Channel 4 room and Walter Presents panel between those scenes.

reference_purposes.Application: The transition connects programme footage, Channel 4 and the Walter Presents collection.
